baseline.decoder: Original morseformer.decoding.streaming.StreamingDecoder, without local boundary or startup changes

scoring: Levenshtein character errors include punctuation and spaces; text is uppercase with leading/trailing whitespace stripped. Noise false characters exclude spaces. Aggregate speech CER is total speech errors divided by total expected speech characters.
decision: All guards must pass. Freeze checkpoint, frontend and thresholds before evaluating final data. Report any failure without changing criteria or tuning further on final results.
